method: GEO-R02C-B2a skyline regression against the protected B1.1 baseline (MEASURED, terrain ray cast, eye 1.75 m, 60° vertical FOV over 800 px).

allowedWindows.why: D2 directly affects the S0-S1 crest from 120 m west of the summit to the Vestfjell plateau start: the south-east arm start cap removes the B1.1 spill-over cone behind the summit, the col is opened and the plateau start moved. North Peak itself (x > -640) stays guarded.

D1 directly affects the west arm beyond the protected 90 m core of Vesttind (the terminal taper fades in between 90 and 210 m): this is the artificially high arm end that formed the 2.08 ha coastal seam, and its terminal profile now descends to the R1 coast. Vesttind itself stays guarded.
